description: Defines the SecurePrefs class for managing secure and regular shared preferences, including encryption, loading, saving, and configuration of various app settings and tokens.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class for managing app preferences securely with encryption support, handling various configuration settings, tokens, and preferences.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Sets the last discovered stable ID in preferences.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name in preferences.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual gateway.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves notification forwarding policy for a specific app package.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Sets the list of notification forwarding packages.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Loads TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Stores TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from secure preferences.

methods.name: putString
methods.description: Stores a string in secure preferences.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from secure preferences.

methods.name: loadOrCreateInstanceId
methods.description: Loads or generates a new instance ID.

methods.name: loadOrMigrateDisplayName
methods.description: Loads or migrates the display name.

methods.name: setWakeWords
methods.description: Sets wake words for voice recognition.

methods.name: loadVoiceWakeMode
methods.description: Loads the voice wake mode setting.
